name: LunaMission Scientific Observatory
description: Framework-neutral mirror of DESIGN.md tokens. DESIGN.md owns the visual rationale.

fontFamily.sans: Inter, Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif
fontFamily.mono: IBM Plex Mono, SFMono-Regular, Consolas, Liberation Mono, monospace

semanticUsage.sun: Sun direction, illumination cues and Sun chart series
semanticUsage.earth: Earth direction and Earth chart series
semanticUsage.dataDemo: Illustrative/demo data only, never a scientific status
semanticUsage.success: Application state only; not mission suitability
semanticUsage.warning: Application caution/qualification; not an implicit failure probability
semanticUsage.danger: Real UI or calculation error; not decoration
